description: Verify MCP tool-call proofs (preview). Parse client_config_json, load agent_key from its seeds, and for each case: canonicalize arguments_json, build challenge_request byte for byte, accept challenge_response at now, and sign. envelope.bundle is the standard base64 of the SPEC-v2 proof bundle wire. ML-DSA-65 signing is hedged in SDKs, so compare the produced wire with the ml_dsa_65 component of challenge_sig replaced by the expected one: the rest, including the deterministic Ed25519 signature, must be identical; the produced and expected bundles must both verify. The configuration's delegations are root side first; the signed bundle carries them leaf first. Every refused_challenges response must be refused, and signing with wrong_agent_key must fail because the last delegation is not issued to it. For each refused_signings entry: check challenge_response for checked_tool under client_config_json at now (it is accepted), then signing a call to signing_tool with signing_arguments_json under signing_config_json (client_config_json when empty) must fail: a checked challenge signs only the tool and the configuration it was checked for.
